parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.description: The name of the data directory.

parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the database that you want to query.

parameters.name: PartitionInputs
parameters.description: The information about the created partition.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise batch-update-data-lake-partitions --catalog-name hive --db-name default --table-name test_table --partition-inputs '["example-string"]' --data-region cn-hangzhou --tid 3000 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise BatchUpdateDataLakePartitions --region cn-hangzhou --TableName test_table --WorkspaceId 120000 --CatalogName hive --DbName default --PartitionInputs '["example-string"]' --Tid 3000 --DataRegion 'cn-hangzhou'
